formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (ρ : V → Option Bool) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause V)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation F π → ∃ π' : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause V), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.restrictCNF F ρ) π' ∧ π'.length ≤ 2 * π.length
plain_statement: For any partial assignment rho, a Res(+) refutation of a CNF F of length S gives a Res(+) refutation of the restricted formula restrictCNF F rho of length at most 2S: substitute constants into every linear equation, drop lines that are valid under rho, and repair resolution steps whose equations collide by one weakening. Instance: PHP restricted to a bipartite graph is graph PHP (seat-pcx-1's route to L-pcx-017).
title: Res(+) is closed under restriction: a refutation of length S gives one of the restricted formula of length at most 2S
